facts.statement: Ferganasaurus is a genus of sauropod dinosaur named after the Fergana Valley.
facts.quote: Ferganasaurus (meaning "Fergana Valley lizard") is a genus of sauropod dinosaur

facts.statement: The species Ferganasaurus verzilini was formally described in 2003 by Alifanov and Averianov.
facts.quote: It was formally described in 2003 by Alifanov and Averianov as the type species Ferganasaurus verzilini

facts.statement: The holotype specimen was discovered in 1966 by Kurzanov and Rhozdestvensky.
facts.quote: The holotype, PIN N 3042/1 (two dorsal and sixteen caudal vertebrae, a pelvis and limb bones), was discovered in 1966 by Kurzanov and Rhozdestvensky

facts.statement: The original holotype fossils were lost, leaving only drawings of the remains.
facts.quote: but it was subsequently lost with only drawings of the holotype remaining

facts.statement: A second specimen was found during a 2000 expedition in the Balabansai Formation.
facts.quote: A 2000 expedition into the Balabansai Formation yielded a second specimen of Ferganasaurus

facts.statement: No skull or cranial bones have ever been found for Ferganasaurus.
facts.quote: no cranial material has ever been attributed to Ferganasaurus

facts.statement: Ferganasaurus reached a length of 18 meters and an estimated mass of 15 tonnes.
facts.quote: Ferganasaurus grew up to 18 m long with an estimated body mass of 15 tonnes

facts.statement: Known remains include a partial postcranial skeleton featuring two long claws on each hand.
facts.quote: Los restos conocidos incluyen un esqueleto parcial postcraneal, donde se destaca la presencia de 2 largas garras por mano

facts.statement: Additional material attributed to the genus includes spatulate teeth similar to those of Jobaria.
facts.quote: Otro materia referible al género incluye dientes espatulados similares a los de Jobaria

facts.statement: Ferganasaurus verzilini is the only known species in the extinct genus Ferganasaurus.
facts.quote: Ferganasaurus verzilini es la única especie conocida del género extinto Ferganasaurus

facts.statement: Ferganasaurus is classified as an eusauropod sauropod dinosaur.
Ferganasaurus lived approximately 160 million years ago during the Middle Jurassic in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a mediados del período Jurásico, hace aproximadamente 160 millones de años en el Calloviense en lo que es hoy Asia

facts.statement: Fossils were found in the sediments of the Balabansai Formation.
facts.quote: en sedimentos de la Formación Balabansai

facts.statement: Ferganasaurus is considered similar to Rhoetosaurus, which reached about 19 meters in length.
facts.quote: Es un saurópodo similar a Rhoetosaurus, que alcanzó aproximadamente los 19 metros de largo

facts.statement: Ferganasaurus lived between 165.3 and 161.5 million years ago during the Callovian age.
facts.quote: Time range: Callovian to Callovian (165.3 to 161.5 million years ago)

facts.statement: The parent group for Ferganasaurus is Eusauropoda.
Ferganasaurus belongs to the class Saurischia.

rejected.quote: It lived in the Balabansai Formation of Kyrgyzstan, which dates to the Callovian stage of the Middle Jurassic
